title: Community Outreach
description: Crime Scene Intercessors and God's Feeding Hands: how Crosstown Community Church serves Stockton.

sections.heading: Community Outreach
sections.text:

sections.altSmall: Crosstown volunteers at a homeless encampment
sections.altBig: An open Bible at a prayer vigil

sections.heading: Crime Scene Intercessors
sections.body: Wednesdays at noon, we gather for prayer at various sites in the city of Stockton, where there has been a homicide. We invite you all to pray with us in person if you're available or from wherever you are at around noon on Wednesdays for our people and our city. Our city needs us to pray. For more information, or to be added to the group texts, e-mail crosstownstockton@gmail.com or register using the form.
sections.asideSuccess: Thanks! We'll add you to the CSI group texts.

sections.heading: God's Feeding Hands
sections.body: We gather at Crosstown on the last two Mondays of the month at 7:30 am to prepare sack lunches followed by an outreach to our homeless community from  9:00 am - 12:30 pm..  If you have a heart to reach the homeless and for community service, we invite you to join us this month!  There is a way for everyone to participate whether praying for people we encounter,  preparing lunches at the church, distributing food, water and clothing, or providing  reliable transportation for the team   members.  Contact Rose Kaufmann at 209-471-4850 for more  information.
